descriptor: Plant delivery service that asks good questions

voice.summary: Sprout & Sons asks questions like a neighbour leaning over the fence: short, friendly and genuinely interested in the answer. It thanks people simply and never makes a survey feel like paperwork.
dos: Ask one thing at a time in plain words
Thank people by name for specific answers
Mention keyboard shortcuts as a friendly tip
donts: Do not use 'valuable feedback' or 'your opinion matters'
Avoid long preambles before a question
Never push a required answer on a sensitive question

taglines: Tell us how you found us
Growing better, one answer at a time
boilerplate: Sprout & Sons delivers healthy houseplants and garden starters to your door, and runs short one-question-at-a-time surveys to learn how customers find and love the shop.

microcopy.success: Thank you. That helps us grow.
microcopy.error: Pick an option before we move on.

logo.note: A sprout is the plainest sign of a plant delivery shop.
